scope: Simulation benchmark using simulator feedback in the outer velocity controller; never sensor-SLAM navigation or real-robot acceptance

time.duration_semantics: profile.duration_s is maximum budget; completed worker truth_controller_completed_t_s plus declared profile.post_completion_s determines earlier normal termination
time.frequency_selector: Only controller_updated=true rows count as feedback updates; original hold/init/parking rows remain for causal coverage
time.native_iteration_coverage: Every original physics_step iteration must be contiguous; same cached state is paired with telemetry

route.heading_reference: causal controller reference_yaw; requested route/heading and feedback time are retained for independent review

speed.metric: mean absolute actual COM velocity projected on the causal nonzero reference velocity minus its norm

parking.trigger: First eligible actual mode=parking zero row after worker/controller completion dwell; requested and actor command and reference XY velocity must all be zero
parking.physical_pose_source: Every original 200Hz native cached state, not chosen quiet window

safety.semantics: All original 200Hz native physics_step qd/tau/contact/attitude; native clearance recomputed from unchanged world.sdf all-static downward ray. Tau is applied force command fed to physics, not measured motor torque.

terrain.step_functional: each actual foot supports the true tread; base proceeds at least 1 m after edge+0.5 m, then final parking; world Z rise alone is diagnostic
terrain.missing_foot_geometry_status: unverified; no strict full ramp or step pass

revision: Schema/time/native-evidence adaptation; all v1 numerical motion and safety thresholds unchanged; old actual archive remains v1
